scope: Single fixed-representation readout training-method exploration; no formal adoption
input: same frozen own-object64; no extra actions,colors,coordinates or IDs fed to network
data: exact previous augmented arm, including unchanged24old+8official schedule; no new sampling
optimizer: unchanged AdamW lr.001 wd.001 clip1, fresh optimizer
BCE: identical previous masked weighted BCE, mean valid objects/state then batchmean

contrastive.form: Eq2 positive log terms averaged outside log; denominator all allowed known positive and negative facts within current predicate
contrastive.identity: SHA256 canonical rgb_static,rgb_gripper,robot_obs arrays + object color; same identity excluded from both numerator and denominator, including every duplicate draw
contrastive.anchor: known fact with >=1 distinct-identity same-label positive and >=1 opposite-label negative
contrastive.reduction: 0.5 mean eligible label0 anchors +0.5 mean eligible label1 anchors; if either class has no eligible anchor, whole regularizer=0 and BCE proceeds unchanged
contrastive.duplicates: repeated draws cannot form self-positive pairs; their other comparisons keep fixed schedule multiplicity, reported explicitly
contrastive.unknown: excluded as anchors and candidates; no relabeling
contrastive.no_positive: skip anchor, never resample or change batch

applicability_before_outcomes.meaning: exploratory feasibility limits, not paper acceptance criteria; fail stops fitting, no batch repair

baseline_reproduction: Run four BCE baselines first; require exact previous augmented parameter tensor hashes before any SupCon fitting. If mismatch, stop and explain, no extra baseline retries.
selection: fixed final600 and threshold.5; no validation/D tuning, no predicted-z secondary this round

literature.basis: paper section3.2.2 Eq2; author code equality mask, self exclusion, dot-product/temperature and mean log positives inspected only
literature.differences: single-view frozen tokens, joint BCE regularizer on existing hidden32, class-balanced valid anchors and duplicate/unknown masks; tau=.1 and lambda=.1 are fixed exploratory choices, not paper reproduction; no temperature/base-temperature extra factor
